notes: Inspiré d'un contenu du label weird_alpha qui a marché chez nous (@mentoridaily, be8abcd5). full test BLEO : accroche jamais faite (format « habits of people who are X in their own company »). cta C (slide Sophia en position 4, conseil à la 1re personne). Slide Sophia en position 4.

slides.texte_overlay:
habits of people who are
happy in their own company

they take themselves out

they go to cafés, cinemas and museums alone without feeling strange about it. treating yourself like good company is the first step to actually enjoying it.

they keep a slow routine

they make their mornings and evenings feel special, with good tea, music and candles. small rituals turn time alone into time they genuinely look forward to.

they stay curious

people who enjoy their own company always have something interesting going on in their heads: a myth, a planet, a painting they learned about that morning. a curious mind is never truly lonely.
slides.texte_sophia:
they stay curious

i used to hate being alone. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a planet, and my own thoughts became the most interesting company i have.

slides.texte_overlay:
they don't fill every silence

they don't reach for noise the moment the room goes quiet. sitting comfortably with your own thoughts is a calm kind of strength most people never build.

they plan little adventures

they plan solo walks, day trips and new recipes just for themselves. when you stop waiting for others to start living, your weekends finally become your own.
